title: From Verb to Infinitive: fut, úszik, táncol

sections.content: Building on -ni, here are three more infinitives: fut ('run') becomes futni, úszik ('swim', an -ik verb) becomes úszni, and táncol ('dance') becomes táncolni. Notice that even -ik verbs form a perfectly regular infinitive -- the -ik pattern only affects the first-person present tense, not the infinitive.
Don't let úszik's -ik ending mislead you into thinking its infinitive is irregular too -- úszni is completely regular. The -ik pattern is only about person and number, never about the infinitive.
